text:
anna: heads-up — customer reported duplicate job creation when our Python SDK retries uploads after transient 5xxs. reproducer below and some proposed mitigations.

anna: minimal repro:
```py
# redwood==0.9.3
with open('payload.bin','rb') as fh:
    resp = client.ingest.create_job(model='text-embed-001', file=fh)
    print(resp)
```
server intermittently returns 502; SDK retries and second attempt results in another job because the stream couldn't be resent. they saw two job ids.

roshan: is the SDK adding an Idempotency-Key header for these calls?

anna: nope, by default we don't. transport layer retries on idempotent-safe rules but upload endpoints are non-idempotent. the bug is we retry the POST body but the second try sends zero bytes (non-seekable file), server accepts it as a new request.

lee: typical approaches: (A) require an idempotency key on mutating endpoints (error or warning if absent), (B) buffer streams so they can be replayed on retry, or (C) always write large streams to tempfile and replay from disk.

roshan: i'd avoid forcing keys on users, too disruptive. prefer opt-in buffering + helper function that creates idempotency keys when users want to avoid buffering. e.g. `client.helpers.make_idempotency(stream)` that uses content-length or hashes prefix.

anna: PoC: added config under retries: `buffer_streams=True, buffer_max_bytes=5_000_000, buffer_mode='fail|tempfile|memory'`. behavior: if stream.seekable() -> rewind; elif size <= buffer_max_bytes -> read into BytesIO and replay; elif buffer_mode=='tempfile' -> write to NamedTemporaryFile; else raise descriptive error telling user to provide Idempotency-Key.

lee: love that. naming nit: `buffer_streams` vs `stream_buffering`. `stream_buffering` reads nicer in docs. Also add telemetry event `sdk.stream_buffered` with size and mode.

docsy: docs action: update quickstart upload example to show explicit Idempotency-Key header and add a short note in upgrading guide about 0.9.4 default behavior (no auto-buffer by default; opt-in). Also add snippet for helper:```py
key = client.helpers.make_idempotency_for(fh)
resp = client.ingest.create_job(..., headers={'Idempotency-Key': key})
```

roshan: don't forget tests: simulate flaky 502s and assert only one job accepted when buffering enabled. add unit that simulates non-seekable stream raising on second read.

anna: one more: backoff behavior needs to stay — we use decorrelated jitter with max_retry 3. but telemetry should track `retry_type=transport|application` and `replayed_stream=true/false`. we'll need a small schema change in parser but it's fine.

qa-bot: QA note: add an integration test against staging with intentional 502 injection to validate tempfile path and memory path.

roshan: also consider raising a warn-level log when we auto-buffer with a short message: "SDK buffered non-seekable body (mode=tempfile, size=XYZ) to allow safe retry" so customers and SREs can see it.

anna: i'll open a PR with impl + tests + docs. will default to disabled and mark as opt-in until we have telemetry and perf numbers.

lee: when PR is up ping me. i'd like to review error messages (they should suggest exact remediation).

docsy: i'll draft the quickstart snippet and an upgrade blurb for the changelog.

anna: thanks — will include changelog entry: "Add opt-in streaming buffering to enable safe retries for non-seekable request bodies; recommend Idempotency-Key for large uploads." :thumbsup:

qa-bot: CI kicked off for branch anna/buffer-streams. tests running...

qa-bot: CI passed — 78 tests, 2 flaky skipped

roshan: nice work. follow-up: maybe an API helper `with client.stream_buffering(enabled=True)` context manager as ergonomic sugar.

anna: good idea, adding to TODO in PR."
